Container.Name: awacino-unattended
Container.Overview: Makes this Unraid server an Awacino unattended device: reach it, its terminal and its network from your phone or computer - no port forwarding. In the Awacino app choose "Add unattended device" -> "Install on NAS" and paste the setup code below.

Config.Name: Setup code
Config.Description: The setup code the Awacino app shows under Install on NAS. Used once; it may be removed after pairing.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Pairing, certificates and client updates. Keep it, or the server has to be paired again.
